body:
## Summary

Serving Claude Code (v2.1.302) through magpie to a DeepSeek model on OpenRouter (`baseAPI: anthropic`, e.g. `deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017`) breaks sessions with two different 400s from OpenRouter's Anthropic-compatible `POST /api/v1/messages`. Both reproduce on magpie 0.1.1285 and are still present on current `main` (checked the code at tags `v0.1.1476` and `v0.1.1564`).

- **A.** `400 {"error":{"type":"invalid_request_error","message":"Invalid Anthropic Messages API request"}}` — the filler thinking block injected by `withThinkingOnToolTurns` has **no `signature` field**, which OpenRouter's strict schema validation refuses for the whole request.
- **B.** `400 {"error":{"type":"invalid_request_error","message":"Mid-conversation reasoning effort (configuration_update) is not supported on <model>"}}` — Claude Code 2.1.302 inserts mid-conversation `role: "system"` messages that carry a per-message `output_config` (an `effort` that varies per operation). OpenRouter converts that into a `configuration_update` and refuses it mid-conversation — on DeepSeek **and** on `z-ai/glm-5.3-flash`.

## Environment

- magpie 0.1.1285 (GUI, `baseAPI: anthropic`); the relevant code is identical on `v0.1.1476`/`v0.1.1564`
- Claude Code 2.1.302 (its payloads contain adaptive thinking, context management edits, and the mid-conversation system messages described below)
- Provider: OpenRouter, endpoint `https://openrouter.ai/api` + `/v1/messages`
- Models: `deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017` (both problems), `z-ai/glm-5.3-flash` (problem B only)

## Problem A — the injected filler thinking block has no `signature`

### Cause chain

`withThinkingOnToolTurns` (added in #1611, extended in #1822) injects a filler block into every assistant turn that calls a tool (or that answers tool results alone):

```go
space, _ := json.Marshal(aBlock{Type: "thinking", Thinking: noReasoning})
```

`aBlock.Signature` is `json:"signature,omitempty"` and the custom `MarshalJSON` only forces `thinking` to be present — so the filler is serialized as `{"type":"thinking","thinking":" "}` with **no `signature` key**. DeepSeek's own Anthropic endpoint takes it, but OpenRouter validates the Messages schema strictly and refuses a thinking block without the `signature` key for the entire request.

Note `anthropicReplaysThinking(host, model)` matches **by model name** (`strings.Contains(model, "deepseek")`) regardless of host — so the injection also fires for OpenRouter-hosted DeepSeek, whose validator is the strict one.

### Evidence

Byte-level A/B against OpenRouter production (key redacted as `$OPENROUTER_KEY`):

1. The same 61-message conversation sent directly to `https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/messages` answers **200**; the same conversation through magpie answers **400** with `Invalid Anthropic Messages API request`.
2. Capturing magpie's outgoing body shows the only difference is the injected block. Replaying that exact body directly answers **400**; removing the injected block answers **200**; adding `"signature": ""` to it answers **200** again.

Minimal reproduction (direct, no magpie):

```bash
curl -s https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/messages \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPENROUTER_KEY" \
  -H "anthropic-version: 2023-06-01" -d '{
  "model": "deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017", "max_tokens": 64,
  "messages": [
    {"role": "user", "content": "hi"},
    {"role": "assistant", "content": [{"type": "tool_use", "id": "t1", "name": "Bash", "input": {}}]},
    {"role": "user", "content": "ok"}
  ]}'   # 200

# the same body after withThinkingOnToolTurns injects
#   {"type":"thinking","thinking":" "}   (no signature)
# in front of the tool_use answers 400 "Invalid Anthropic Messages API request";
# with "signature":"" added it answers 200 again.
```

## Problem B — mid-conversation system messages carrying `output_config` become a refused `configuration_update`

### Cause

Claude Code 2.1.302 inserts `role: "system"` messages into `messages[]` mid-conversation and puts a per-message `output_config` on them:

```json
{"role": "system", "output_config": {"effort": "medium"}, "content": [{"type": "text", "text": "..."}]}
```

The `effort` varies per operation (`high` on one call, `medium` on the next). OpenRouter turns such a message into a reasoning `configuration_update` and refuses it mid-conversation; the error names the model, e.g.:

```
Mid-conversation reasoning effort (configuration_update) is not supported on z-ai/glm-5.3-flash-20260826
```

Two separate failures hide behind this:

1. a `role: "system"` message alone makes OpenRouter lose the conversation's thread — a request that changed nothing answers 400 (removing the system message from the captured body makes the same request answer 200);
2. `output_config` is accepted **only on system-role messages** — so once the message is re-roled, keeping it is a schema error: `output_config is only supported on system-role messages` (OpenRouter's validator detail at `messages[N].output_config`).

### Evidence (magpie → OpenRouter, model matrix)

| request shape | deepseek-v4.1-flash | glm-5.3-flash |
|---|---|---|
| tool_use turn, no thinking block | 200 | 200 |
| top-level `output_config.effort` high, then medium on later turns | 200 (until a system message arrives) | 200 |
| mid-conversation `role: "system"` message, no output_config | 400 `Invalid Anthropic Messages API request`* | 200 |
| mid-conversation system message **with per-message `output_config.effort`** | 400 `Mid-conversation reasoning effort (configuration_update)…` | 400 same error |

\* (that one is the A/B combination seen in a real session: with the filler's signature fixed, the system message alone still derails DeepSeek's conversation tracking)

## Potential fixes

A working local patch (two commits, `internal/gateway/anthropic.go` + `gateway.go`, ~125 lines, existing tests updated) verifies end-to-end; happy to open a PR:

1. **A — one-point change:** build the filler as a raw message with `"signature": ""`:

   ```go
   space := json.RawMessage(`{"type":"thinking","thinking":"` + noReasoning + `","signature":""}`)
   ```

   OpenRouter accepts an empty signature (its own replies carry `signature: ""`), and DeepSeek's own endpoint takes a signed block the same way it takes the unsigned one. Three existing tests' expected bytes need the same update (`deepseek_anthropic_thinking_test.go`, `deepseek_step_lead_test.go`).

2. **B — fold the system messages on the OpenRouter path** (the same gate `anthropicReplaysThinking` already uses, plus a host check): re-role mid-conversation `system` messages to `user`, drop their per-message `output_config.effort`, and hoist a `format`, if one ever came, to the body's top level (where OpenRouter takes it).

3. **B — keep the reasoning shape constant:** whatever the client or the model slot asked, one request of a conversation must look like the others. Options: strip the client's `output_config.effort` and pin thinking to one fixed budget (what the patch does — `budgetOf("high")`), or track the first effort seen per conversation. Claude Code varies effort per operation, so per-slot variance cannot survive this endpoint.

Scope note: fixes 2–3 are only needed where OpenRouter's conversation tracking is in play; DeepSeek's own endpoint (`api.deepseek.com/anthropic`) and other upstreams are untouched when the transforms stay behind the host check.
title: [Bug] gateway: OpenRouter's Anthropic endpoint refuses DeepSeek turns without a thinking signature, and mid-conversation system messages carrying output_config
